primary_intent: Use a close, personable unboxing reveal and tactile product-detail demonstration to make the viewer curious about the product, then invite a follow-up try-on demonstration.
audience_and_platform: Short-form vertical social-commerce viewers, especially fashion shoppers who respond to quick UGC unboxing and close product-detail proof.

evidence.observation: Presenter addresses the lens immediately with both hands framing the microphone and unopened package.
Package is drawn toward camera, lifted and opened in one continuous reveal.
Product is removed, its protective layer is peeled away and its front is held square to camera.
Fingers demonstrate tactile details with synchronized Foley.
Presenter asks viewers to request a fuller follow-up test.

cut_allocation.script_instruction: Keep the target adult presenter centered, direct-to-camera and conversational; preserve the quick move from greeting to package contact.

Adapt the incompatible console interaction into a neutral-box dress reveal: lid removal, folded-dress reveal, lift, controlled partial unfolding and close lace/detail presentation; claim only visible features.
Hold the dress detail or upper bodice square to camera and invite a full try-on follow-up without promising fit, fabric performance or results.

compliance_boundary: no misleading material, fit, comfort, slimming, quality or certification claim
remove source brand marks and do not invent a target brand
uncertainties: The supplied product photo proves visible construction and appearance only; material composition, sizing, comfort and fit are not verified.

The source product and target dress have incompatible form factors, so physical interaction is a Level 2 functional migration while timing, camera, reveal order, delivery and CTA rhythm remain locked.
